gumroad_listing.title: Florida Licensed Real Estate Agents & Brokers — 2026 Database — 448,610 Records (CSV)
gumroad_listing.description:
Every Florida-licensed real estate agent and broker on record with the Florida DBPR — 448,610 records from the same public weekly CSV used by RealEstateAgentData.com and BookYourData, at a fraction of their price.

**What's included:**
- Licensee name
- DBA name (where filed)
- Rank: Sales Associate / Broker / Broker Associate
- Primary status: Active or Inactive
- Mailing address: street, city, state, ZIP
- County (FL county)
- License number
- Original license issue date
- Expiration date
- DBPR source URL — every row verifiable

**Key stats:**
- 448,610 total records
- 319,247 Active licensees
- 368,514 Sales Associates | 48,525 Brokers | 31,571 Broker Associates

**Important notes:**
- Data is sourced from the Florida DBPR (Department of Business and Professional Regulation) public records system — the official state licensing database
- Mailing address is the address on file with DBPR as the licensee's official contact address
- No personal email, no personal phone — this is a clean B2B licensing dataset
- Buyer is responsible for complying with applicable contact laws (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, Florida § 501.059) and must not use this data for consumer solicitation

**Who buys this:** Real estate SaaS SDRs, mortgage lenders, title companies, E&O insurance brokers, CE providers, proptech vendors — anyone who needs to reach Florida's 300K+ active licensees without paying for a national database subscription.

**Data source:** Florida DBPR Real Estate Commission — public government record, updated weekly, no auth bypass.
